title: OneDrive: Prompt Gallery for Copilot in OneDrive on the web
notes: claim 48: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the licensing classification treats this new option inside Copilot in OneDrive as an add-on rather than an inclusion in the existing product licence. The access guidance also overlooks the separately enabled SharePoint licence component, and the statement that caps are not applicable lacks evidence. The roadmap facts and the licence-assignment path and command are supported.

claims.quote: licensing: model: "add-on"; rationale: cost: "The Copilot in OneDrive integration comes with the Microsoft Copilot licence". SCHEMA defines included as "part of a licence the product already needs; name it".
